children: Procore completed the acquisition of DroneDeploy for approximately $845.0 million in cash.
Procore consummated the merger with DroneDeploy on September 9, 2026, making DroneDeploy a wholly-owned subsidiary.
Purchase price was approximately $845.0 million in cash, subject to adjustments for working capital, transaction expenses, cash, and indebtedness.
Merger follows the Agreement and Plan of Merger announced July 27, 2026; full agreement filed as Exhibit 2.1 to Procore’s July 29, 2026 8-K.
